tools.name: get_career_certificates

tools.name: get_career_education

tools.name: get_social_profiles

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_music, search_project_notes, get_career_certificates, fetch_curated_page_context, get_contact_email, get_about_resume · Private data: get_professional_profile, get_download_documents, get_career_certificates, get_first_party_context, search_first_party_context, get_contact_email · Public sink: get_contact_email, get_about_resume.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_music, search_project_notes, get_career_certificates, fetch_curated_page_context, get_contact_email, get_about_resume · Private data: get_professional_profile, get_download_documents, get_career_certificates, get_first_party_context, search_first_party_context, get_contact_email · Public sink: get_contact_email, get_about_resume

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
